seo.title: What is a content management system?
seo.description: A content management system is the software your team uses to add and edit website content without a developer.

definition: A content management system is the software your team uses to add and edit website content without a developer.
answerBlock: A content management system is the software your team uses to add and edit website content without a developer. It stores the words and images, controls who may change them, and decides what a page looks like when it is published. WordPress is the best known, but the category is much wider.

body.heading: What separates a good CMS from a bad one?
paragraphs: A good one models your content. If you sell services, a service is a record with its own fields: a title, an answer, deliverables, a price band, questions and answers. Adding a service then produces the page, the listing entry, the menu link, the sitemap entry and the social preview automatically.

A bad one gives editors a blank canvas and a box of widgets. Every page becomes a one-off, nothing is consistent, and the site slowly becomes impossible to change because no two pages are built the same way.
The editing experience decides whether the system is used at all. If publishing a page requires a developer, the site stops being updated, and a site nobody updates stops earning traffic.

commercial.heading: Why does it matter commercially?
paragraphs: The real cost of a CMS is not the licence, it is what it costs to publish. A marketing team that can ship a landing page in an afternoon runs more campaigns than one that waits three weeks for a deployment.
Ownership matters as much as convenience. Content that lives in a database you control can be exported, migrated and analysed; content locked inside a proprietary page builder cannot.

example.heading: What does it look like in practice?
example.body: Cascadia Health replaced fourteen separate clinic sites with one system where a clinic is a record, so opening a new location produces its page, its listing entry and its booking journey without a deployment.

service.title: WordPress development
service.line: Custom WordPress themes and WooCommerce stores without page-builder bloat, with structured content your editors can manage safely.

terms.definition: A page builder is a drag-and-drop editor that lets someone assemble a web page from blocks without writing code.
A plugin is a package of code that adds a feature to a content management system without changing the system itself.
